title: WW3 GPU Lab: hands-on WAVEWATCH III modelling and a C++/Kokkos GPU port
description:
A self-paced course and toolkit for the WAVEWATCH III (WW3) third-generation spectral wind-wave model, aimed at running and accelerating it on GPUs.

  • Build and run the Fortran model on real cases, with a pinned Nix toolchain and annotated switch files.
  • Benchmark it on CPU (OpenMP, MPI) and GPU (OpenACC, CUDA Fortran).
  • Port its kernels to C++/Kokkos for performance portability, starting with W3SNL1, the Discrete Interaction Approximation (DIA) of nonlinear four-wave interactions, and check numerical parity against the Fortran reference with a field-by-field tolerance harness.

Includes 16 lessons, runnable examples, exercises with solutions, and an undergraduate project proposal (Escola Politécnica, UFRJ).
